articles.summary: Rare earths are the hidden materials powering many of today’s most advanced defense technologies, from fighter jets and drones to radar and autonomous systems. Yet China’s dominance of refining and magnet production has created a critical supply-chain vulnerability. Explore how governments are responding and why the race to build secure rare earth supply chains outside China is creating a growing investment opportunity.
articles.title: Rare Earths Deliver the Hidden Power Behind Modern Defense

articles.summary: Gold and silver surged in August as rising debt, higher term premiums and growing concerns about U.S. fiscal credibility revived the currency debasement trade. Gold is increasingly behaving as “outside money,” supported by strong central bank buying, while silver is benefiting from renewed investor demand, persistent supply deficits and tight inventories. We examine why these forces may be setting the stage for the next move in precious metals.
articles.title: Gold and Silver Surge as Fiscal Credibility Erodes
